claim.ja: すべての複素K3にCAP。κ=0の極小曲面はOka、極小class VIIではHopfまたはEnokiと同値。射影的K3とEnriquesはelliptic。
claim.en: CAP for every complex K3. Minimal κ=0 surfaces are Oka; in minimal class VII, exactly Hopf and Enoki are Oka. Projective K3 and Enriques surfaces are elliptic.

role.ja: 二方向のstripから局所操作と任意次元の凸近似を作り、周期の三分岐をTorelliで移送。補間・分類・sprayの入力を分ける。
role.en: Two strip directions give local extension and convex approximation; Torelli transfers three period cases. Separate inputs supply interpolation, classification, and sprays.
